verdict.rationale: Mastra documents agent memory with 'thread-aware storage', but nothing in the evidence shows a user can inspect, edit, or delete remembered items, or that the memory store sits locally in an open format. Having a memory feature, running the server locally, and self-hosting model gateways are adjacent capabilities, not this one.

support.subject: As a privacy-first user, I can inspect, edit, and delete what the assistant has remembered — the memory store lives on my machine in an open format
